pageProps.title: Death 1
pageProps.review: A review of Bernard Werber's novel, featuring a fresh premise where a protagonist who realizes they are dead tracks down their own killer, along with honest impressions of the work.
pageProps.description: My name is Gabriel Wells. I am a mystery writer, and a 'rookie' soul who has just recently died.
pageProps.content:
## Review If I had to describe this book in one sentence, it would be: Who killed me? At first, the protagonist doesn't even realize he's dead, but once he does, he starts searching for the killer, convinced someone murdered him intentionally.
The fresh part of this book is that the victim themselves deduces the killer's identity. It was a novel enough premise to make the book an interesting read. However... somehow, it felt a bit lacking.
